patch.value: Drop the dead SDK export shim and exporter cast, and gate host-owned flags on sdk/contracts

Remove the obfuscated sdk export shim (Record<string,unknown> laundering + computed-string listAllFrontMatter fallback) and import listAllItemMetadata directly. Drop the unnecessary cast around registerExporter and type changelogExportMetadata as ImportExportRegistrationOptions. Measure api.registerExporter.length on the real 2026.7.28 host: it is 3, so the legacy registerFlags fallback branch is dead code under the declared peer floor and is deleted along with its hand-built api double test. Add a contracts gate test that imports GLOBAL_FLAG_CONTRACTS/SUBCOMMAND_GLOBAL_FLAG_CONTRACTS from sdk/contracts and asserts the extension declares no host-owned flags, with a negative case.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: measured api.registerExporter.length = 3 on the real 2026.7.28 host via activateExtensionForTest; the legacy registerFlags fallback branch (api.registerExporter.length < 3) is DEAD code under the declared peer floor (>=2026.7.28). Deleted the branch and its hand-built api-double test; added a test pinning that export flags arrive via the exporter options object. Removed the sdkExports Record<string,unknown> shim + computed-string listAllFrontMatter fallback; imported listAllItemMetadata directly (SDK ItemMetadata[] flows to PmItem[] without a cast). Removed the as-unknown-as registerExporter cast; typed changelogExportMetadata as ImportExportRegistrationOptions (no mismatch found). Added test/host-flag-contracts.test.ts importing GLOBAL_FLAG_CONTRACTS/SUBCOMMAND_GLOBAL_FLAG_CONTRACTS from @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/contracts.
